module: Small Track Builder utility that smoothly moves the free camera to a target position and rotation. It interpolates position (linear) and rotation (nlerp) with an inverted quadratic ease curve (1-(1-t)²), on each onPreRender, via core_camera.setPosRot.
notes: The interpolation is applied only if commands.isFreeCamera() is true (free camera); otherwise the transition runs with no visible effect.
Bug: in lerpTo, the time <= 0 branch passes quat.w (the field of the quat class, probably nil) instead of rot.w to core_camera.setPosRot.
currentQuat is initialized with vec3(0,0,0) but then receives a quat; harmless since it is overwritten before use.
The pos and rot arguments are stored by reference (no copy).

lerpTo.desc: Starts a transition from the current camera to (pos, rot) over time seconds. If time <= 0, places the camera immediately.

time.desc: Duration in seconds; 0 or less for an immediate jump.

onPreRender.desc: Hook called before each render: advances the transition, computes the interpolated position and rotation and applies them to the free camera.

dt.desc: Time elapsed since the previous frame (s).
